summary: A Proxy is callable if and only if its target was callable when ProxyCreate ran; an apply trap cannot make a non-callable target callable.

target.notes: Use the JavaScript object-model runtime. Proxy semantics require trap lookup, handler calls, target internal methods, revocation checks, and invariant enforcement.

semantics.capability: [[Call]] is installed only when IsCallable(target) is true
semantics.apply_trap: can intercept calls only on a callable proxy
semantics.dynamic_handler: later handler changes cannot add callability to a non-callable proxy

caveats: Do not model Proxy as a plain C# decorator or Dictionary wrapper; observable internal-method interception and invariants must be preserved.

tests.name: apply trap cannot make object callable
tests.input: const p=new Proxy({}, {apply(){return 1}});console.log(typeof p);try{p()}catch(e){console.log(e instanceof TypeError)}
